Reason for Mistake: Incorrect comparison of director birth dates due to incorrect assignment of birth dates to the wrong directors. This is a logical error where the agent failed to perform the basic comparison of the two verified numbers (1932 < 1955), leading to a false conclusion that the later-born director was born earlier.
